description:
Industry’s most powerful PDF Reader Solution.

View, annotate, form fill, and sign PDF across desktop, mobile, and web – no matter if you’re at the office, home, or on the go.
New Features and Improvements in Foxit PDF Reader 2026.2.0.39747
- Meet the newly enhanced Foxit AI Assistant - empower your work with intelligent Workspace and smarter interactions.
  - Introduce Foxit Workspace
    Create a project around your documents or a topic, then work with AI to review source materials, extract and organize information, draft content, and develop reusable and sharable outputs (including documents, images, presentations, mind maps, diagrams, infographics, web pages, and Markdown). Foxit Workspace transforms document-based work into a more connected process to help users complete real tasks, not just chat.
  - Enhanced AI Chat experience - The redesigned AI Assistant Chat has been upgraded from a standard Q&A interface to an Agent that can execute in cycles, maintain context, and invoke tools. Under this agent-based structure, previous tools listed in More tools and certain ribbon commands have been redesigned as skills or generation modes via Chat. The enhanced AI Chat also supports additional AI models, default connected apps (MCP connectors), and skills creation and management.
  - Support for Local AI with BYOM and SLMs - Provide strict data security by keeping document content within the user's environment while giving users control over which AI models run through custom models with Bring Your Own Model (BYOM) and enabling efficient on-device processing with SLMs.
  - Make document translation easier to control by letting users choose the pages to translate, choose Danish as a target language, and follow language-aware guidance during translation.
  - The redesigned Intelligent Reading has been separated into two standalone features, Read Aloud and Smart Podcast, providing a more streamlined way to explore, understand, and work with document content. The Read Aloud feature has been further improved to support reading selected text and highlighting the text currently being read.
- Add Arabic to the application interface for a more localized experience.
- Enhance Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MIP) support (Enterprise Packaging only)
  - Display the sensitivity labels that apply only to files, keeping the labeling experience focused.
  - Update the justification experience to ensure a complete, reliable audit trail for label changes.
  - Extend support to organizations using Azure Government Cloud (GCC High).
- Allow administrators to make enterprise-defined stamps available from a shared drive or local OneDrive folders so users always access the latest stamp set, with optional restrictions on end-user editing. All configurations can be managed through Foxit Customization Wizard or GPO settings.
- Improve certificate workflows by supporting the import of trusted certificates in CRT format and automatically recognizing timestamps embedded in certificates.
- Other enhancements to the user experience.
Issues Addressed in Foxit PDF Reader 2026.2.0.39747
- Fixed some stability issues.
